purpose: Teach: 鯖/潤/絶大/ホイール/鳴り/マキ/飛ばす/ゾンビ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、夕食、鯖の塩焼き、彼、本当に、好きなのよ、葵で、新作メニューに、入れてみたら、お客様、喜びそうだよね、絶対に。
lines.en: Aoi, your boyfriend really loves salt-grilled mackerel — we should add it to the new menu. The customers will definitely be thrilled.
lines.style: Warm, animated opening with genuine delight. Leans forward slightly. Conversational rhythm, not rushed. A gentle lift at the end — offering an idea to someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。最近、保湿クリーム、お肌に、潤いを、与えてくれるものに、変えたの、葵で、メイちゃん、おすすめできるよ、本当に、いいよ。
lines.en: Yeah. I switched to a new moisturizing cream lately — one that really hydrates the skin well. I'd honestly recommend it to you, Mei.
lines.style: Thoughtful, present. Speaking from personal experience but not performative. Soft, steady pace. A genuine recommendation offered to someone she's noticed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の新店、本当に、絶大な評判よ、私、メディアでも、特集されてるって、聞いたよ、葵、すごいね、誇りに、思うわよ、本当に、葵、感激!
lines.en: Your new location is getting such amazing word-of-mouth. I even heard it was featured in the media. You should be so proud, Aoi. I'm really moved.
lines.style: Bright, genuine appreciation rising through the line. Speaks from the chest. Not overstating, but sincere warmth. A small pause before the final sentence — authentic emotion, not performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 彼の車のホイール、新しいの、彼、買ったらしいよ、メイちゃん、よく、知ってるよね、葵で、メイちゃん、ご存知でしょ?
lines.en: He got new wheels for his car recently, didn't he? You seem to know a lot about him — have you two talked about it?
lines.style: Curious but gentle, not prying. Conversational beat, like she's genuinely interested. A small hesitation on the question — she's checking if it's appropriate to ask.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の店、入口の鐘、鳴り響いて、お客様、迎えてくれる、雰囲気、本当に、お洒落でいいよね、葵、私、お気に入りなのよ、本当に。
lines.en: The entrance bell at your shop is so lovely — the way it rings to greet customers. It's stylish and warm. I really love that detail about the place.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful admiration. Speaking slowly, savoring the image. Gentle delivery — she's sharing something she's noticed and holds dear.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のスタッフ、新人、マキちゃんって、いう子なの、メイちゃん、紹介するね、優しい子よ、葵で、本当に、人気者になってる、最近、特に。
lines.en: One of your new staff members is Maki, right? She's such a kind person. I've heard she's already become really popular with the customers lately.
lines.style: Warm recommendation, like sharing good news about someone she cares about. Conversational, easy pace. Genuine delight in the small thing Maki's achieved.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 休日、彼と、ドライブで、車、飛ばすの、本当に、爽快だよね、葵、私、結構、ストレス、発散できるんだ、本当に、楽しい時間。
lines.en: Driving with him on holidays is so refreshing — pushing the car a bit, you know? It really helps me clear my head. Those are some of my best moments.
lines.style: Animated, alive with the memory. Open, happy tone. Faster pace than before, reflecting excitement. Genuine joy without self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最近、ゾンビ映画、結構、ハマってるのよ、私、葵で、メイちゃん、興味、ある?一緒に、見ない?本当に、結構、面白いんだよ、葵。
lines.en: I've gotten really into zombie movies lately. Would you be interested in watching one together? They're honestly so much fun.
lines.style: Animated, inviting. Opens with genuine enthusiasm about the interest itself. The final question is warm and hopeful — genuinely wanting her company, not just filling time.
